controllerMethod: Actual document controller and its one Runtime, history and publication are included. Commands measured are native-generated functions. 17 alternating batches after 3 warmups; batch means are not individual event percentiles. Both columns are explicit; the largest fixture has a 10000-item single column.
controllerExclusions: Initial import, DOM, network and peak memory are not inside operation timings.
Empty point and move commands compare rejection of invalid access, not useful item work.
B0 is a weaker mutable baseline; B1 and COW preserve stronger snapshot semantics.
The compiler profile is local synthetic producer evidence, not a proof over all inputs or future scheduling.

byteCatalogues.method: Actual native-generated modules bundled with all reachable runtime helpers, distinct field paths and exported commands. Reference is the generic COW command implementation. No padding or fabricated timing profiles. Both alternatives are bundled independently for size measurement; this is not automatic runtime admission.
limits: Command-only and complete document-controller entry graphs are both measured. The command-only controller includes Runtime, shared publication and history with identical exports in both variants; unrelated routes and UI dependencies are not part of this fixture.
These measurements do not include worker/Wasm assets not referenced by this experiment.
Source maps are debug artifacts and not included in the runtime byte totals.

browserRows.method: Actual browser document-controller/Runtime/history; native-generated command functions. Nine alternating batches after three warmups. No DOM, network or initial import in operation timing; means within batches are not event percentiles.
limits: One page/engine exploratory run, not independent physical-device replications.
Timer-limited zero values do not establish free work.
A generated function is measured independently of automatic admission; unqualified cases are not silently selected in a release.
